resample.notes: Downgraded. GPU-CPU-GPU round-trip only in aggregate path for non-integer scale factors. Interpolation (nearest/bilinear/cubic) stays on GPU. No GPU kernel exists for irregular per-pixel binning.

polygon_clip.notes: Fixed: pass dask chunks to rasterize() so mask stays lazy for dask inputs.

kde.notes: Graph construction serialized per-tile. _filter_points_to_tile scans all points per tile. No HIGH findings.

sieve.notes: False positive. Memory guards already in place on both dask paths. CCL is inherently global — documented limitation. CuPy CPU fallback is deliberate and documented.

bump.notes: Fixed: int32 coords, default-count cap at 10M, memory guard, per-chunk dask partitioning via dask.delayed. Graph serialization reduced ~250x.

reproject.notes: Downgraded to MEDIUM. Fast path .compute()-in-loop is intentional (~22x faster); falls back to map_blocks when output exceeds GPU VRAM. 16x16 thread blocks already mitigate register pressure in cubic kernel.

rasterize.notes: Downgraded. Tile-by-tile graph construction with per-tile geometry filtering is the correct pattern. Pre-filtering ensures each delayed task gets only its relevant subset. O(n_tiles) bbox check at graph-build time is vectorized and fast.

pathfinding.notes: Downgraded. CuPy .get() is required -- A* has no GPU kernel. Per-pixel .compute() is only 2 calls for start/goal validation. seg.values in multi_stop_search collects already-computed results for stitching.

geotiff.notes: False positive. open_geotiff(chunks=N) returns lazy dask array. to_geotiff auto-routes dask inputs to write_streaming. Eager paths are by design for numpy/cupy.

zonal.notes: Memory guards improved, iterrows replaced with isin. da.unique().compute() confirmed safe (small result). regions() is inherently global - documented limitation.

viewshed.notes: Tier B memory estimate tightened from 280 to 368 bytes/pixel (accounts for lexsort double-alloc + computed raster). astype copy=False avoids needless float64 copy.

visibility.notes: Fixed: _extract_transect uses vindex for point extraction, cumulative_viewshed accumulates lazily with da.zeros + da.Array addition. All 3 HIGH findings resolved.

proximity.notes: Memory guard added to line-sweep path. KDTree path (EUCLIDEAN/MANHATTAN + scipy) already had guards. GREAT_CIRCLE unbounded path already guarded.

glcm.notes: Downgraded to MEDIUM. da.stack without rechunk is scheduling overhead, not OOM risk.

surface_distance.notes: Memory guard added to dd_grid allocation.

cost_distance.notes: Memory guard added + da.block assembly. Finite max_cost path (map_overlap) was already safe.

mahalanobis.notes: False positive. Numpy path materializes by design. Dask path uses lazy reductions + map_blocks.

aspect.notes: northness/eastness now use da.cos/sin on dask arrays.

diffusion.notes: Scalar diffusivity now passed as float to chunks. DataArray diffusivity passed as dask array via map_overlap.

normalize.notes: Boolean indexing replaced with lazy nanmin/nanmax/nanmean/nanstd.

balanced_allocation.notes: Lazy source extraction + memory guard. Algorithm is inherently O(N*size) - documented limitation.

erosion.notes: Memory guard added. Algorithm inherently global.

dasymetric.notes: Memory guard added to validate_disaggregation. Core disaggregate uses map_blocks.
